answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> False Sects Question ID: 49604 Country: India Title: moharram Question: Whether taziyadari and alamdari, as per Hanafi fiqh, is allowed or not? Please elaborate. Answer ID: 49604 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 205/203/N=02/1435) The painful shahadat (martyrdom) of Sayyidna Hussain (رضی اللہ عنہ) is undoubtedly one of the most tragic events of history which took place in the month of Muharram. But the customs of taziyadari, alamdari and other bid’ats (innovations) invented by the Shias in order to express their grief conspiratorially against the Muslims is unlawful and haram according to the all Ulama as per the Shariah. All Muslims should refrain from these acts. For details, see: Majalis Abrar, Majlis No. 37. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
